about_the_game:
City Defense Z is a single-player strategy game where you build your city by day using randomly drawn building cards and fight to survive relentless zombie attacks by night.

Each new day brings a set of building cards such as Barracks, Ammunition Workshops, and Factories. You place them strategically on the map, combine buildings of the same type to upgrade them, and reinforce your city's defenses. Time is limited during the day, so you must think fast and act smart. When night falls, waves of zombies advance with increasing strength and unpredictability. If you're not well-prepared, everything can fall apart in a single night.

Resources are scarce. Time is short. The threat is growing. Your city's fate depends not only on your planning but also on your defense.

Key Features

  • Build and expand your city during the day using randomly drawn building cards.

  • Merge buildings of the same type to unlock 15+ unique upgrades.

  • Balance your resources between ammo, troops, and construction.

  • Defend your city with your trained soldiers against the undead.

  • Prepare reinforcements during the day to call in support at night.

Building Types

Barracks – Arm soldiers each round to defend your city.
Ammunition Workshop – Increase ammo production at the start of each round.
Factory – Produce resource points needed to place buildings each round.

Every game brings a new city. Every night is a new test. How long will your city stand?
